additional_info.subject: Missing chargePointSerialNumber in BootNotification
additional_info.body:
Hi Colleagues,
We have observed an inconsistency in the BootNotification messages coming from two different charging stations. As shown in the logs below, the field chargePointSerialNumber is missing for one device, while it is correctly present for the other one.
Our CPO has confirmed that there is no backend-side configuration that can suppress or modify this parameter — it is expected to be provided directly by the charger. Therefore, they rely on the device to always send this value.
Device-(170003656 & 170003655):
-chargePointSerialNumber missing-
2026-01-05T15:01:16.545147+00:00 [FW080104G2] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/a854d9d3abee[2192]:
OCPP: Send command: BootNotification (3b7ebf8f-0033-4f00-901d-1a768b838a9c) -
{"chargePointModel":"SICHARGE D","chargePointVendor":"Siemens AG","firmwareVersion":"v8.1.4-0-g5b0f2d0 (PRODUCTION)","iccid":"90011521120181652F"}
Other Device (CPO is different) (chargePointSerialNumber present):
2026-01-06T08:12:57.470833+00:00 [FW080104G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/8d1bff5294f4[2219]:
OCPP: Send command: BootNotification (8057fb79-468d-41e2-97f8-709fb7c42a0d) -
{"chargePointModel":"SICHARGE D","chargePointVendor":"Siemens AG","firmwareVersion":"v8.1.4-0-g5b0f2d0 (PRODUCTION)","iccid":"90011830220282785F",
"chargePointSerialNumber":"Y2/R7313065117122"
}
Could you please advise how we should proceed with this?
Do we need to look for a device-side configuration, provisioning issue, or a firmware-related root cause?
Your guidance on the expected behavior and next steps would be highly appreciated.
